headline: PRIN PROP experiences a -100.00% price gap amid a disapproved AGM resolution.
market_take: The property sector led today's moves with several stocks up double‑digits, notably AWC +11.94% and RML +11.11%, while the CONMAT and consumer sectors faced sharp declines, highlighted by GEL -25.00% and PLE -22.22%. Unusual trading activity was widespread, with price gaps, volume spikes and intraday swings across food, prop and PF&REIT names. A cluster of high‑impact filings—including a capital‑change for QHBREIT and a connected‑transaction filing for STPI – adds further context to the volatility.

sector_notes.note: AWC surged +11.94% with a 4.5σ volume spike and +9.49% intraday move; RML and CGD also posted >10% gains. PRIN recorded a -100.00% open gap and its AGM resolution was disapproved.
MADAME posted a 5‑day gain of +27.40% and an intraday rise of +9.72%; AQUA showed a -9.09% open gap and +10.00% intraday move, while XBIO fell -11.11% on an open gap.
GEL dropped -25.00% with an open gap; TTCL rallied +33.30% over five days and filed a SET clarification; TPIPL added +7.06%.

PLE intraday fell -22.22% and is down -22.22% overall; SOLAR and CNT posted intraday declines of -8.33% and -6.19% respectively; TTCL surged +33.30% and STPI showed a +5.47% open gap alongside a high‑impact connected‑transaction filing.
SSPF rose +6.87% with a +7.55% intraday move; M‑PAT declined -6.47% (5‑day -13.30%); QHBREIT announced a paid‑up capital reduction; FUTURERT disclosed a related‑party transaction.
